fact: At a meeting in Lome on 8-9 June 2023 the customs directors general of nine states including Niger committed to full operation of SIGMAT, which shares transit declarations electronically between customs offices of departure, transit and destination.
title: Le Système Interconnecté pour la Gestion des Marchandises en Transit (SIGMAT) de la CEDEAO désormais opérationnel dans neuf (9) Etats Membres
